summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the new sticky SectionNav across all 15 pages (11 content + home + trip programme + hub + region) on desktop (1440x820), tablet (768x1024) and mobile (390x844). Verified: (1) nav present on all pages, (2) every discovered section id resolves to a real DOM element (zero dangling anchors), (3) clicking every button smooth-scrolls the target section to sit exactly 16px below the sticky nav (uniform diff=16 across pages), (4) clicked button gets data-active='true' with the terracota underline, (5) manual scroll updates active correctly (verified mar-map -> mar-nav-mar-map, mar-faq -> mar-nav-mar-faq), (6) mobile ul is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth >> clientWidth on every mobile page, e.g. sur-nav 1867 vs 358) and active tab auto-centres/scrolls into view, (7) HOMING REGRESSION fix confirmed on 4 image-heavy pages (program-pricing, mar-routes, sur-why-xaluca, viajes-proximas) — click from very top before any scroll lands perfectly at diff=16, (8) header auto-hide + sticky follow verified: at scrollY=0 nav sits below header (headerBottom=118, navTop=820); after scroll-down header hidden (headerTop=-118) and nav sits near viewport top; after scroll-up header re-appears (top=0) and nav re-flows below it.
action_items: NON-BLOCKING: /viajes/surdemarruecos emits 5x React 'Encountered two children with the same key' console warnings on load. Pre-existing content-data issue unrelated to SectionNav (likely duplicate keys in an itinerary/section list). Consider adding unique keys in the sur region page item map.
NON-BLOCKING: /contacto and /citaprevia log 'requestStorageAccess: Permission denied.' — coming from an embedded third-party widget (booking/whatsapp/analytics). Unrelated to SectionNav.
critical_code_review_comments: SectionNav.jsx (211 lines) is well-focused, single-responsibility and reusable. Homing rAF scroll + 180ms/480ms correction snaps + clickLock during IO makes navigation drift-proof on lazy-image-heavy pages — regression verified fixed on 4 image-heavy pages.

Scan-line IntersectionObserver with rootMargin `-${headerH+navH+40}px 0px -${vh-lineY-1}px 0px` is a clean approach; the last-section fallback via scrollHeight-scrollY guard handles the bottom edge correctly.

Sticky follows the auto-hiding header via getElementById('data-testid=site-header').offsetHeight + scroll direction with THRESHOLD=12. Works correctly across all viewports; no overlap detected in any test.
Consider memoising resolveLabel with useCallback (minor optimisation) — not a bug.
The `active` visual state is driven both by data-active and by a Tailwind conditional class on the underline span — both consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SectionNav feature is fully working on all 15 pages (home / viajes / quehacemos / que-ver-en-Marruecos / equipo / incentivos / cuando-viajar / marruecos / contacto / opiniones / vuelos / citaprevia / trip programme / atlas_desierto hub / surdemarruecos region) across desktop/tablet/mobile. Every click lands sections at exactly navBottom+16px. Homing regression fix confirmed. Active-highlight works on both click and manual scroll. Mobile horizontal scroll works with all pages showing overflow. Header auto-hide + sticky follow chain verified. Two pre-existing console-warning issues (duplicate React keys on /viajes/surdemarruecos, and requestStorageAccess on /contacto and /citaprevia) exist but are unrelated to SectionNav and non-blocking.
rca of the issue: No bugs. Feature implementation is production-ready.
